components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled action button; primary call to action on every screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2e2a33; color: #f5f3f8; border: 1px solid #2e2a33; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6b6572; border-color: #6b6572; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8d8c9; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent ghost button; used for Cancel in the policy modal.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #2e2a33; border: 1px solid #2e2a33; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #cfc9d6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8d8c9; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Identifier Input
components.description: The name field; typed value renders in the display serif.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #cfc9d6; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', serif; font-size: 1.1rem; background: #ffffff; color: #2e2a33; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, outline-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2e2a33; outline: 2px solid #a8d8c9; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6572; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: The recurring label/value document row used for every fact stated about an identifier.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #cfc9d6; padding-top: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-ledger-label { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b6572; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger-value { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #2e2a33; text-align: right; }

components.name: Credential Card
components.description: The single centered surface every screen is built from: ruled header over a body slot.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 28rem; width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cfc9d6; padding: 2.5rem; } .ds-card__header { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #2e2a33; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfc9d6; padding-bottom: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Policy Modal
components.description: Centered dialog with a ruled ledger-style header, shown before a claim is confirmed.
components.html:
Policy

Before you claim

components.css: .ds-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(46,42,51,0.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-modal__content { background: #ffffff; max-width: 24rem; padding: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid #cfc9d6; } .ds-modal__header { border-bottom: 1px solid #cfc9d6; padding-bottom: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-modal__header h2 { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #2e2a33; margin: 0; }

components.name: Stamped Seal
components.description: Double-ring rotated seal mark shown only on the issued-credential screen.
components.css: .ds-seal { width: 68px; height: 68px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #2f6b52; outline: 1px solid #2f6b52; outline-offset: 3px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: rotate(-3deg); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2f6b52; text-align: center; line-height: 1.1; }

narrative.overview: The claim flow reads as a document being processed, not a form being filled out. A single ruled card sits centered on a pale lavender-white ground; every value on it — name, issue date, status — is presented as a row in a ledger, labeled in a small uppercase serial tag and right-aligned like an entry in a records book. The identifier itself is the one word in the whole interface set in serif, because it is the one thing being formally issued; everything that operates the interface (buttons, labels, status text, body copy) stays in a plain system-UI sans so it never competes with the credential. Color is rationed to a single restrained pastel per meaning — sage-mint for available/success, dusty rose for unavailable/void — never as a broad field, only as text, a hairline accent, or the seal ring. Depth comes from ruling, not lighting: hairline borders and horizontal rules do the work shadows would do elsewhere, and the one moment of ornament — the rotated double-ring 'Issued' seal — is reserved exclusively for the successful-claim state. Motion is minimal and fast (150–200ms, no easing drama), present only to soften a modal's arrival or a focus/hover state, never to perform.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger-row layout: label left, value right, hairline rule above.
One serif reservation: the identifier name only.
One pastel accent per meaning, applied to text/rings, never as a fill.
Flat, bordered surfaces; no shadows anywhere in the build.
Near-square 2px corners everywhere except the one fully round seal.

rules.name: The One Meaning, One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage-mint means available/success and dusty rose means unavailable/void, full stop — neither pastel is reused for any other purpose, and neither ever fills a large surface; both live in text, rings, or a single hairline.

rules.name: The Ledger-Not-Lighting Rule
rules.body: Separation between surfaces is drawn with a 1px hairline border in --color-line, never a shadow. Depth is structural, not atmospheric.

rules.name: The One-Serif Reservation Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 renders the identifier name and nothing else. Titles, buttons, labels, and body copy stay on the system sans even when bold or large.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ledger-Label Rule
rules.body: Serial-style field labels are 0.7rem, uppercase, 0.05em tracked, and set in muted plum — never the primary ink color. This is a structural label for a value that follows it, not a decorative pre-headline kicker, and it does not migrate onto marketing or narrative copy.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by border and background-value contrast only. A shadow on any card, input, or modal is a deviation from the shipped system.

dos: Do reserve Source Serif 4 for the identifier name value alone; every other text element (including bold titles) stays on the system sans.
Do express availability/unavailability through the deep text-safe accent variant (#2f6b52 / #9c4a5c) plus a semantic device (strike-through for unavailable), never through a filled colored surface.
Do build depth with hairline borders and canvas/paper value contrast; keep every surface shadow-free.
Do keep corners at 2px or square (0px) except the seal, which is the one circle in the system.
Do use the ledger-row pattern (uppercase label / hairline rule / right-aligned value) for any new fact the app states about an identifier or credential.
donts: Don't introduce a box-shadow anywhere; the build has none, and one would break the ruled-document read.
Don't fill a surface with the pale mint or rose swatch as a background field — both accents are confirmed as text/ring/outline use only in the shipped build.

Don't extend the uppercase serial-label device (0.7rem, tracked, muted plum) into a decorative pre-headline kicker on marketing or narrative copy; in this build it is strictly a value's field label inside a ledger row.
Don't add a second circular or rotated mark. The stamped seal is reserved for the successful-claim state; reusing its geometry elsewhere would dilute the one moment it's meant to punctuate.
Don't promote JetBrains Mono to general UI labels — the fix round explicitly moved mono off UI labels onto the sans face; mono is confirmed for the seal's micro-copy only.
